character: Yvette Delacroix and Dr. Ptahsheptut Smith
voice: Yvette uses charm and leverage deliberately; Smith remains proud and guarded, with both speaking fluent English.

entries.text: Dr. Smith, I appreciate your help so much.
Well, I do not particularly appreciate giving it. I have things to do, Miss Delacroix. Important things.
Surely you can spare enough time to help me move my desk.
Oh, I suppose. Why do you want to move it?
There is a terrible stain on the rug. I do not want it to show, and the desk need not move far.
All right... Ah! It is heavy! Ow!
Oh, I am so sorry. Did you hurt yourself?
Yes! Oh, no, I am bleeding. You owe me one, Miss Delacroix.
Of course, Dr. Smith. I will do anything you ask. Anything. I let you into the museum, and I kept your secret, did I not?
Yes, I suppose you did. And I am sorry about bleeding on your carpet. At least it will blend with the old stain. What is that, anyway?
I am sure I do not want to know, Yvette.
Probably not, Dr. Smith. Now, let us go to your place.
